softwareInnerHero.title: Transform Your Document Workflow
paragraphs: Bluebeam Revu is the leading PDF solution for architecture, engineering, and construction teams, designed to streamline project workflows and enhance collaboration.
Revu enables real-time collaboration, customizable PDF markups, and centralized document management, reducing errors and eliminating paper-based processes.
Whether in the office or on-site, teams can work more efficiently, accelerate project delivery, and maintain accurate records.
From design reviews and punch lists to as-builts, Bluebeam Revu simplifies every phase of construction, helping teams deliver high-quality projects on time and within budget.

cardSections.subheading: Discover how Bluebeam Revu transforms document workflows

items.title: Advanced Markup Tools
items.body: Customize and save toolsets for consistent markups. Use text, shapes, clouds, and more to communicate clearly and effectively with your team.

items.title: Real-Time Collaboration
items.body: Collaborate in real-time with Studio Projects and Studio Sessions. Share markups, track changes, and keep everyone on the same page throughout the project.

items.title: OCR & Search
items.body: Convert scanned images into text-searchable PDFs with advanced OCR technology. Quickly find information across all your project documents.

items.title: Punch & Tracking
items.body: Create, assign, and track punch items directly in your PDFs. Link markups to data for seamless project management and reporting.

items.title: Form Creation
items.body: Turn any PDF into an interactive form with customizable fields. Collect data electronically and integrate with your existing systems.

items.title: Cross-Platform Access
items.body: Access your projects anywhere with Revu for iPad and Revu for Windows. Work seamlessly between devices without losing functionality.
